palette: deep tobacco green, dark bottle green, warm amber, warm off-white cream, a little warning red.

shots.prompt: A huge single tobacco leaf glowing softly in a dark greenhouse at night, dew drops on it, mysterious green light from inside its veins, a tiny person standing below it looking up.
A cigarette and a sleek unbranded disposable vape lying side by side on a dark wooden table, a thin curl of smoke and a soft cloud of vapor rising and mixing, moody amber lamp light.

A tall tobacco plant standing alone in a dark field at night like a fortress, its broad leaves like armored shields, a faint green glow inside the stem, small beetles turning around and walking away from it.
Macro close-up: a green caterpillar biting the edge of a big tobacco leaf, frozen mid-bite, tiny yellow electric sparks around its body, dark soft background.
A seventeenth-century kitchen garden: a gardener in old-fashioned clothes sprinkles brown tobacco water from a wooden bucket onto rows of cabbages, a wattle fence, soft morning light.
A vintage brown glass poison bottle with a plain paper label showing only a black leaf and a skull symbol, standing on a dusty wooden barn shelf, sunbeams through the planks.
A tractor spraying a wide golden crop field, a pale chemical mist drifting across the field, a few bees flying away from the mist, late afternoon light.
Close-up of honeybees on bright wildflowers in a meadow, peaceful sunny day, soft bokeh background.
Side view silhouette of a teenager's head in the dark, the brain inside glowing warm orange with tiny sparks, a thin wisp of vapor leaving the lips.
An old brass balance scale on a dark background under a spotlight: on one pan a single small vape pod, on the other pan a whole pack of cigarettes, the scale perfectly balanced.
A giant hourglass standing in an empty dark space under cold blue light, sand pouring down, the falling grains forming tiny human silhouettes.
A tobacco plant in a field at sunset, a line of small beetles walking away from it towards the horizon, long golden shadows.
An unbranded disposable vape and a fresh mango slice on a dark table, a sweet orange vapor cloud curling upwards and forming the shape of a fishing hook.
